subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Green Defaults for Energy
description: A quick win: understand Green Defaults for Energy.

hook.text: Germany offered green energy as the default. Over 90% of customers stayed on it.

buildup.text: Green defaults enroll people in renewable energy plans and let them opt out to conventional sources if they prefer.

discovery.text: Pichert and Katsikopoulos found that green defaults are the single most effective tool for increasing renewable energy.

twist.text: Critics argue people pay more without realizing it. But the opt-out is easy and most who switch back do so for price.

climax.text: Green defaults show that environmental behavior isn't mainly about values. It's about what's set up for you.

punchline.text: Want a greener world? Change the default.

quiz.question: What makes green defaults effective?
options: They force people to use only renewable energy
Most people don't switch away from whatever is pre-selected
